description: Observed-order sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/hjweno_norm_D1_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/hjweno_norm_1d_eikonal_dirichlet_mms.esm. Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*hjweno(u) + S|g'| with Dirichlet walls gL=0.5, gR=1.5 and exact solution g = sin(2 pi x) + 0.5 + x; the error is the fifth-order HJ-WENO-Z truncation S*(|g'| - hjweno(g)) = O(dx^5). g is smooth so WENO-Z stays fifth order at the u_x=0 critical points, and g is antisymmetric about the walls so the mirror-ghost faces reproduce g's smooth extension and stay fifth order; both L2 and Linf fall as O(dx^5) (expected order 5). Julia tolerances pinned tight so temporal truncation stays below the finest spatial error.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried (loosest reltol 1e-6; all three solvers Erk/Bdf/Sdirk wedge). earthsci-toolkit-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so on this stiff / non-smooth-min-max / large-AST RHS it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
